tasks.label: Check: shell syntax
tasks.detail: bash -n 覆盖安装器与仓库里的 shell 脚本
tasks.command: for f in finx-install/install.sh finx-install/selftest.sh install.sh setup.sh mirror/install.sh pre-build-test.sh dpkg-checkall.sh; do bash -n "$f" || { echo "FAILED: $f"; exit 1; }; done && echo 'shell syntax OK'

tasks.label: Check: indentation
tasks.detail: Perl 用 tab、shell 用 4 空格；heredoc 与 POD 自动跳过。修正用 scripts/format_check.pl --fix

tasks.label: Check: perl syntax
tasks.detail: perl -c 覆盖全部模块。必须先 test_setup，否则 perlmod/Fink/FinkVersion.pm 还不存在
tasks.command: make test_setup && for f in perlmod/Fink.pm perlmod/Fink/*.pm perlmod/Fink/*/*.pm; do out=$(perl -Iperlmod -c "$f" 2>&1) || { echo "FAILED: $f"; echo "$out"; exit 1; }; done && echo 'perl syntax OK'
